name: SMT101 Direct Sensors
description: Reads SMT101 temperature and humidity directly from device input events and exposes them as Kiosk Satellite entities.
author: Stuart Pearson

settings.title: Enable temperature and humidity
settings.description: Expose direct SMT101 temperature and humidity entities.

settings.title: Temperature event device
settings.description: Fallback event device number used when the SMT101 temperature system property is unavailable.

settings.title: Humidity event device
settings.description: Fallback event device number used when the SMT101 humidity system property is unavailable.

settings.title: Temperature property name
settings.description: Android system property used to discover the temperature event device.

settings.title: Humidity property name
settings.description: Android system property used to discover the humidity event device.

settings.title: getevent command
settings.description: Shell command used to stream direct SMT101 input events.
